# Test clips

`hi_1.wav`, `hi_2.wav`, `ta_1.wav`, `bn_1.wav` are from Google's FLEURS
dataset (test split), licensed CC-BY-4.0
(https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs). `clips.tsv` lists each
clip's FLEURS sentence id, file name and transcription. Used unchanged
(16 kHz mono WAV) to test Tark's live captions (D4).

`golden.json` is generated by `utils/captions_export.py golden` from these
clips, AI4Bharat's IndicConformer (MIT) and Silero VAD (MIT).
